t: You're looking at Durning Library, a public lending library at 167 Kennington Lane, in Kennington. It's part of Lambeth Libraries, and it sits in a purpose-built building that is Grade II listed. The library is named after Jemina Durning Smith, a British philanthropist who lived from 1843 to 1901, whose name it carries. The material I have doesn't say more about her giving, but the name tells you this was a place meant for the public to use.
